minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a contractor's yard permit at 305 Leominster-Shirley Road and a townhouse permit at 711 Mass Ave.
minutes.summary: The ZBA held two public hearings by Zoom. It granted a special permit for a construction company's contractor's yard, then one for eight townhouses in two buildings, with conditions on the stone wall and a parking space. After the vote, an abutter criticised how landscape screening conditions are enforced.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment on the contractor's yard petition; none came.
Chair asked for public comment on the townhouse petition; none was seen at that point.

After the vote, an abutter on Mass Ave said vegetative screening conditions on past projects were not maintained or enforced. He asked for follow-up enforcement and raised concern about headlight glare and the visitor parking space at the dangerous curve.

votes.motion: Approve the special permit for the contractor's yard at 305 Leominster-Shirley Road, subject to conditions from the fire department and board of health.
votes.outcome: passed (roll call; four ayes heard plus the chair, who announced the permit granted)

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for townhouses at 711 Mass Ave, with a continuous stone wall in front, the one visitor parking space moved, and a note that no zoning relief is given.
votes.outcome: passed (roll call; ayes heard from all members and the chair, who announced the permit granted)

budget_items.topic: Financing of the property acquisition and rehabilitation (305 Leominster-Shirley Road)
budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant said financing for the purchase and improvements was in process. The purchase is contingent on the special permit.
The tax collector reported real estate and personal property taxes due on the property.

budget_items.topic: Sewer privilege fees for the townhouse project
budget_items.what_was_said: The sewer department noted the site was assessed for three units and the plan is for eight, so additional privilege fees will be due. The applicant must go before the sewer commission.

decisions.decision: Special permit for the contractor's yard at 305 Leominster-Shirley Road granted, with the standard post-decision instructions read.
Special permit for eight townhouses at 711 Mass Ave granted, with the standard post-decision instructions read.
The applicant agreed to make the front stone wall continuous and to turn one visitor parking space parallel to the road for a bigger setback.
The chair encouraged the abutter to bring screening and glare concerns to the Planning Board's site plan review.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for a contractor's yard at 305 Leominster-Shirley Road, subject to fire department and board of health conditions.
It then granted a special permit for eight townhouses in two buildings at 711 Mass Ave, by roll call.
The townhouse permit carries a continuous front stone wall, one visitor parking space turned parallel to the road, and a note that no zoning relief is given.
The sewer department said the site was assessed for three units against a plan for eight, so more privilege fees will be due and the applicant must go before the sewer commission.
After the vote an abutter said past screening conditions were not enforced and raised headlight glare; the chair pointed him to Planning Board site plan review.

why_it_matters: Eight new townhouse units on Mass Ave add housing and new sewer connection fees, and put a new commercial yard in use on Leominster-Shirley Road, which affects neighbors there.
The abutter's complaint shows that landscape screening conditions attached to permits depend on follow-up enforcement, and the minutes do not say who checks them after approval.
watch_next: The applicant's appearance before the sewer commission on the added privilege fees for the townhouse project.
Planning Board site plan review of the townhouse project, where the chair directed the abutter's screening and glare concerns.
